## Oliphant(3pp) (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Huge animal  
 **Init** +0; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 8, flat-footed 16 (+8 natural, –2 size)  
 **hp** 126 (9d8+54); Diehard  
 **Fort** +11; **Ref** +6; **Will** +7  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** gore +14 (2d8+13), 2 stamps +13 (2d6+9)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** trample (2d6+13, DC 23)  

**Tactics**

 An oliphant attacks with its downward curving tusks and heavy forelegs; its trunk is too short to be used as an effective weapon.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 28, **Dex** 11, **Con** 21, **Int** 6, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 11  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +17; **CMD** 27 (31 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Iron Will, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  
 **Skills** Intimidate +11, Perception +9  

**Ecology**

**Environment** cold plains  
 **Organization** solitary (male), family unit (2–8, 25% chance to be accompanied by a calf if 3 or more are encountered)  
 **Treasure** none
